svg.title: Thirty Days to an Instrumented, Permission-Bounded Pilot
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-thirty-day-evidence-sprint; chart type: timeline_roadmap; title: Thirty Days to an Instrumented, Permission-Bounded Pilot; subtitle: Build operating evidence first; first commercial deal remains a 2-6 month assumption.; chapter number: 12; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Four sequential milestones cover Days 1-30. Numeric values represent milestone end days, not durations or revenue. The sprint does not assume that state registrations, venue access, or partner contracting finish within thirty days.; caption: Finish with tested analytics, replay-safe attribution, separate revenue books, and a funded next-step plan; activate only the activities whose permissions and contracts are established.; stages: label: Days 1-7; value: Define scope and evidence ownership; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Choose the initial regulated analytics source and a narrow state affiliate footprint. Inventory CTA, IB, FCM, and vendor questions against 7 U.S.C. 1a and 6d and agency requirements. Draft separate SaaS and affiliate contract checklists, cash budgets, and source-access records.; label: Days 8-14; value: Build isolated feed and event paths; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Implement timestamped ingestion, settlement-term matching, fee normalization, and stale-feed suppression. Build a separate server-to-server event path with signature checks, idempotent identifiers, and synthetic CPA fixtures. Test location uncertainty, blocked destinations, and duplicate events without sending real user funds or orders.; label: Days 15-21; value: Exercise eligibility and settlement logic; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Test the 21+ product policy, jurisdiction restrictions, current offer disclosures, and responsible-gaming contact placement. Reconcile sample CPA rejection codes and NGR deductions, including partner-specific negative carryover. Verify that simulated invoices and commission statements never book trading volume or deposits as revenue.; label: Days 22-30; value: Close pilot evidence and next-month budget; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Run a small permitted analytics pilot and activate affiliate links only where required status and partner authority are documented. Reconcile the $362,500 revenue bridge and $137,750 owner-profit model, assign incident owners, and budget the remaining 2-6 month path to the first deal without treating pilot traffic as earned revenue.

text.title: Thirty Days to an Instrumented, Permission-Bounded Pilot
text.tspan: Thirty Days to an Instrumented, Permission-Bounded Pilot

circle.title: label: Days 1-7; value: Define scope and evidence ownership; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Choose the initial regulated analytics source and a narrow state affiliate footprint. Inventory CTA, IB, FCM, and vendor questions against 7 U.S.C. 1a and 6d and agency requirements. Draft separate SaaS and affiliate contract checklists, cash budgets, and source-access records.

label: Days 8-14; value: Build isolated feed and event paths; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Implement timestamped ingestion, settlement-term matching, fee normalization, and stale-feed suppression. Build a separate server-to-server event path with signature checks, idempotent identifiers, and synthetic CPA fixtures. Test location uncertainty, blocked destinations, and duplicate events without sending real user funds or orders.

text.title: Build isolated feed and event paths
text.tspan: Build isolated feed and event paths

circle.title: label: Days 15-21; value: Exercise eligibility and settlement logic; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Test the 21+ product policy, jurisdiction restrictions, current offer disclosures, and responsible-gaming contact placement. Reconcile sample CPA rejection codes and NGR deductions, including partner-specific negative carryover. Verify that simulated invoices and commission statements never book trading volume or deposits as revenue.

label: Days 22-30; value: Close pilot evidence and next-month budget; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Run a small permitted analytics pilot and activate affiliate links only where required status and partner authority are documented. Reconcile the $362,500 revenue bridge and $137,750 owner-profit model, assign incident owners, and budget the remaining 2-6 month path to the first deal without treating pilot traffic as earned revenue.

text.title: Close pilot evidence and next-month budget

Assumptions: Four sequential milestones cover Days 1-30. Numeric values represent milestone end days, not durations or revenue. The sprint does not assume that state registrations, venue access, or partner contracting finish within thirty days.
